---
name: "nf-core/homer_groseq"
description: "Basic process of trying to analyze GRO-Seq data with HOMER. From the\
  \ [GRO-Seq Analysis Tutorial](http://homer.ucsd.edu/homer/ngs/groseq/groseq.html)."
keywords:
- "homer"
- "groseq"
- "nascent"
components:
- "unzip"
- "homer/maketagdirectory"
- "homer/makeucscfile"
- "homer/findpeaks"
- "homer/pos2bed"
input:
- bam:
    description: "list of BAM files, also able to take SAM and BED as input"
    pattern: "[ *.{bam/sam/bed} ]"
- fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "The reference fasta file"
    pattern: "*.fasta"
- uniqmap:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional HOMER uniqmap"
    pattern: "*.zip"
output:
- tagdir:
    type: "directory"
    description: "The \"Tag Directory\""
    pattern: "*_tagdir"
- bed_graph:
    type: "file"
    description: "The UCSC bed graph"
    pattern: "*.bedGraph.gz"
- peaks:
    type: "file"
    description: "The found peaks"
    pattern: "*.peaks.txt"
- bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "A BED file of the found peaks"
    pattern: "*.bed"
authors:
- "@edmundmiller"
maintainers:
- "@edmundmiller"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/unzip@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/homer/maketagdirectory@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/homer/makeucscfile@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/homer/findpeaks@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/homer/pos2bed@0.0.0-6d1763b"
